summary: T1 Energy Inc. (formerly FREYR Battery) filed an 8-K on August 28, 2026, to attach a legal opinion regarding shares covered by a resale prospectus supplement. The supplement registers up to 32,258,059 common shares issuable upon conversion of its 4.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, including make-whole shares, assuming physical settlement. The filing is routine registration mechanics, not an event-driven special situation; no securities are sold by the company, and no proceeds accrue. The registrant is the issuer. The 8-K merely provides the Skadden legal opinion and consent. What to watch: potential future conversions or resales by selling stockholders, but no immediate special-situation catalyst.
